descriptions.w3d_d20e_rsqrt_table_801f3f28: Allocates a 128-byte table through 0x801fe220 into the global at 0x804ab8d0 and fills it with the rounded upper mantissa bits of 1.0f (literal 0x803b0ec0) divided by the square-root routine 0x802e82c0 applied to the 128 floats 0x3f000000 | (i << 17) in [0.5, 1); sets entry 64 to 255 and returns 0.
